info.title: Kairos research API

get.description: Web page or PDF to clean Markdown: main content extracted (navigation and ads removed), headings, lists, links and tables kept, links made absolute; PDFs as text with page count. Honours robots.txt, refuses private and internal addresses, limits of 2 MB HTML, 8 MB PDF and 15 seconds. Nothing is stored. AI-generated data and analysis; not financial advice.

Optional topic (for example base, stablecoin, solana, etf); default is crypto in general. English-language sources via The GDELT Project. AI-generated data and analysis; not financial advice.
